subject: planner: code prepare for support OR list nested in AND list for mv index (#51780)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent (0ed511a84b00e1c2731ea199763861a268bd58df) focusing on MV-index planning/stats wiring: refactors in `pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go` (candidate-path handling, `PrepareIdxColsAndUnwrapArrayType`, `collectFilters4MVIndex` returning an access-filter type, and stricter `checkFilter4MVIndexColumn` validation for `json_contains/json_overlaps`), plus signature updates in `pkg/planner/cardinality/selectivity.go` and `pkg/statistics/table.go`. The new checks remain conservative (reject unsupported/unsafe MV-index access filters and fall back to normal planning) and plan-cache safety for JSON-array parameters is still triggered during actual MV-index range construction (`buildPartialPaths4MVIndex` calls `jsonArrayExpr2Exprs(..., true)`). No Blocker/High correctness, SQL semantics, data consistency, concurrency, or session/transaction issues found in the touched planner/statistics logic.
